notes: CRM notes: Riverbend is a fast-growing marketplace for specialty home goods. Primary pain: outdated keyword search returns poor product sets and high CPCs on paid channels. They index ~4M SKUs today (8M variants) and expect 40% catalog growth during seasonal prep (Black Friday peaks ~10x query volume). Current stack: hybrid Elasticsearch + in-house heuristics; exploring RAG-style candidate retrieval via embeddings + lightweight neural rerank for top-20 candidates. POC goals: relevance uplift (NDCG+), stable p50/p95 latency under load, and unit economics: target cost per user search <$0.002. Procurement leaning to Dedicated for predictable throughput, but security wants VPC + EU residency for EU storefronts. Technical asks: embedding refresh cadence daily, near-realtime indexable product metadata (price/stock), fallbacks to lexical BM25 when cache cold, transparent per-route token/cost telemetry. Key quote from Remy (VP Product): "We will consolidate if Redwood proves rerank cost + latency — show us numbers during a 10x traffic sim."
